description: POC field-selection test set for fast_jev_test (fictional FAST-NUCES-style data). Expected fields were written before any JEV results were seen. 'ambiguous_with' lists defensible alternatives; picking one still counts as incorrect but is reported separately.

test_cases.notes: 'From' suggests hometown (students.city), but campuses.city also contains Peshawar.
enrollments.semester_name holds Fall/Spring, not a number.
Overall performance is CGPA; per-course marks are a weaker proxy.

test_cases.campaign: Reach students who are about to graduate.
test_cases.notes: student_status contains 'Graduating'; semester 8 is an indirect signal.

test_cases.campaign: Find students with strong academic performance.
Target students in their final year.
test_cases.notes: Final year = semesters 7-8; admission_year is an indirect proxy.
Genuinely ambiguous: 'enrolled' could mean admitted to the university or enrolled in a course. Kept as specified.

test_cases.campaign: Find students who need financial support.
Find students enrolled in Database Systems.

test_cases.notes: Marks are per enrollment, so this joins students -> enrollments.

test_cases.campaign: Find students who got an A grade in any course.
Find students in the Artificial Intelligence department.
Find students studying at the Karachi campus.
test_cases.notes: Requires students -> departments -> campuses. campus_name 'Karachi Campus' vs campuses.city 'Karachi' are both defensible.
Two conditions. A single-choice question can only return one; excluded from single-field accuracy.

test_cases.campaign: Target active students with CGPA above 3.5.
test_cases.notes: Two conditions. Excluded from single-field accuracy.
